s1.description: The hook: the whole TCG market restarts from one vault.

s2.description: The world: the Cartel, its grunts, the rivals and the card game they all chase.

s3.description: The pot: fixed print runs released in slices, never reprinted.

s4.description: The core loop: a weekly drop heartbeat with an idle backbone.

s5.description: The four lanes players start in and grow across.

s6.description: The economy: prices, grading, selling, Cartel moves and rivals.

s8.description: Art direction: a parody homage to the TCG we grew up with, matched to this deck.

s8b.description: The rarity ladder: a card mock for every tier, from commons to Gilded Rares and goofy promos.

s8c.description: The rest of the look: slabs, the desk and the art scope.

s9.description: How we build it, how it makes money, and where the crew comes in.
